decision_conditions:
<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:Aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:
minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-language:
AR-SA">The combined first and second floor extensions and changes to the roof
would result in a loss of character and diminution of heritage significance and
cause harm to to the original dwelling and the Conservation Area. Accordingly,
the proposal would conflict with NPPF London Plan policy HC1 and MLP policy
D12.5 due to the harm caused to the significance of the Conservation Area and
Locally Listed Building.&nbsp;</span></p>

<p><span style="font-size:12.0pt;line-height:107%;
font-family:&quot;Arial&quot;,sans-serif;mso-fareast-font-family:Aptos;mso-fareast-theme-font:
minor-latin;mso-ansi-language:EN-GB;mso-fareast-language:EN-US;mso-bidi-language:
AR-SA">The siting, scale, form and massing of the combined first and second
floor extensions would be result in poor design for the host building which
fails to respond to its context including its historic context in relation to
the original dwelling and in relation to dwellings in the locality. Therefore
the proposal would harm the character and appearance of the host dwelling and
the surrounding area contrary to MLP policy D12.3 and D12.4.</span></p>
description: ERECTION OF A REAR TWO-STOREY EXTENSION; 2 x ROOFLIGHTS; REMOVAL OF REAR CHIMNEY STACK, REMOVAL OF SOME EXISTING AND ADDITIONAL WINDOWS ON SIDE ELEVATION; NEW TIMBER SUPPORT TO PORCH; REPLACEMENT OF GLAZED ROOF ON SIDE EXTENSION AND 2 x ADDITIONAL ROOFLIGHTS.
